page.layout: One printed page: an engraved plate (Prometheus bound to a cross-like frame, with a landscape and ruined column) occupying the centre; partly hidden marginal note fragments in the left margin, running down beside the plate; the printed "P: 211" at the upper right of the plate.

main_text.p: Marginal note fragments at the left, partly covered by the plate: "A" / "fchyl[?]" / "μασ[?]" / "λισ[?]" / "appel[?]" / "lat[?]" / "Prom[?]" / "theo[?]".

page.notes: The page is almost entirely an engraving with no running text. The left-margin notes are cut off by the plate, so most words are incomplete and the Greek fragments are doubtful. The blue library stamp at the lower centre is not transcribed. The "P: 211" is printed on the plate itself and is given as the page number.
